title.zh: 签名留证：perworld L v2 灯 S-3 验证窗获用户双签（计划 + baseline_free 13,028 / signed floor 9,956 + 旧 stash 漂移已知事实 + 失败条款；零 GPU）
title.en: Signature record: per-world L v2 light S-3 validation window dual-signed by the user (plan + baseline_free 13,028 / signed floor 9,956 + old-stash drift known fact + failure clauses; GPU-free)

intent.zh: 用户 2026-11-11 通过聊天卡选项「双签 S-3（计划 + floor 9,956）」签署 S-3。本卡只做**签名留证**：① S-3 receipt `status` 转 `signed_pending_window`、`signed_object=true`（含 boundary），新增 `signature` 块（signer=user / signed_at=2026-11-11 / Asia/Shanghai / method=聊天卡选择 / scope=S-3a 计划（guards 107 条、参考 5 文件 11,078,239 B、实体 `bab01507` 与 QA 链、§2.4 对账 `Compared` 要求、冻结与零编译纪律）+ S-3b（baseline_free 13,028 / signed floor 9,956 / `floor_effective=max(signed,现场)`、不复用 S-2 的 13,302/10,230）+ 旧 stash 漂移已知事实与裁定 + 失败条款），写死 `material_sha256=` README `437dc793…`/18,694 B 与 `does_not_open_window`（仍需 QA PASS + Chief G-L2 token + 现场 floor 取更高 + monitor 60/60 + 零编译 + `live==guard==stash`）；② 三处 `signature_status` 统一为 S-1 signed / S-2 signed / S-3 signed 2026-11-11，S-1 `signatures_required` 的 S-3 行同步 SIGNED；③ S-3 README 加版本记录与 §7 已签口径；④ 三处 manifest 重算自核。**spec.md 字节零改动**：提交前后各算一次 sha256/bytes，必须仍为 `bb064fe0…`/39,379 B。零 GPU、不采集、不开窗、不改 `src/`/`tests/`/`fixtures/`/`scripts/`。
intent.en: The user dual-signed S-3 on 2026-11-11 via chat card (plan + floor 9,956). This card only records the signature: S-3 receipt status to signed_pending_window, signed_object true (including boundary), new signature block (signer user, signed_at 2026-11-11 Asia/Shanghai, method chat card, scope S-3a plan - guards 107 entries, reference five files 11,078,239 B, entity bab01507 with its QA chain, section 2.4 reconciliation requiring Compared, freeze and zero-compile discipline - plus S-3b baseline_free 13,028 / signed floor 9,956 / floor_effective=max(signed,onspot), not the S-2 values 13,302/10,230, plus the old-stash drift known fact and ruling, plus failure clauses), with material_sha256 = README 437dc793.../18,694 B and does_not_open_window (still needs QA PASS + Chief G-L2 token + on-the-spot stricter floor + monitor 60/60 + zero compile + live==guard==stash); unify the three signature_status blocks as S-1 signed / S-2 signed / S-3 signed 2026-11-11 and mark the S-3 line of signatures_required SIGNED in the S-1 receipt; add the S-3 README version record and the signed wording; recompute and self-check the three manifests. spec.md bytes must not change: sha256/bytes before and after must still be bb064fe0.../39,379 B. GPU-free, no capture, no window, no src/tests/fixtures/scripts change.

acceptance: **卡与范围**：卡 id `2026-11-11-render-perworld-l-v2-validate-window-s3-signature`，owner Arch，p80，depends_on = S-3 fill 卡 + S-3 完整预审卡；写入范围仅 `docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/perworld-l-v2-validate-window-s3/` 的 receipt/README/manifest + `docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/perworld-l-v2-light-criterion/receipt.json` 与 `manifest.txt` 的 signature_status/signatures_required 同步 + `docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/perworld-l-v2-capture-window-s2/receipt.json` 与 `manifest.txt` 的 signature_status 同步 + 本卡与 runs；**spec.md 不碰**。
**spec.md 冻结自核**：提交前后各算一次 `spec.md` sha256/bytes，必须逐位等于 `bb064fe0a85ab38abba8043768666a0d9f73fc53d9f2f3dd72eace060c8a924d` / 39,379 B；前后值写入 S-3 receipt `signature` 块。

**S-3 receipt 签名块**：`status` → `signed_pending_window`；`signed_object` false → true（含 boundary 内同名键）；新增 `signature`：signer=user、signed_at=2026-11-11、timezone=Asia/Shanghai、method=聊天卡选择、scope=S-3a 计划 + S-3b（baseline_free 13,028 / signed floor 9,956 / `floor_effective=max(signed,现场)`、不复用 S-2 数值）+ 旧 stash 漂移已知事实与裁定 + 失败条款，`material_sha256=437dc793…`/18,694 B，`does_not_open_window` 写死仍需 QA PASS + Chief G-L2 token + 现场 floor 取更高 + monitor 60/60 + 零编译 + `live==guard==stash`。
**signature_status 三处统一**：S-1/S-2/S-3 三处 receipt 的 S-3 条目为同一字符串（signed 2026-11-11，含双签范围与「不构成开窗」）；S-1 receipt `signatures_required` 的 S-3 行改 SIGNED（additive，不动 S-1/S-2 已签事实与 spec 判据）。
**README 版本记录**：S-3 README 加「用户签名 S-3（2026-11-11）」条目（签名对象 README `437dc793…`/18,694 B、scope、签名后 README sha 变化属预期、签名不构成开窗、留证卡 id）；§1 P4 行与 §7 标题改为已签口径；签署前定稿说明更新为「预审已 PASS + 用户已签」。
**manifest 与门禁**：S-3/S-1/S-2 三处 manifest 重算并各自自核；四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit；`unchanged src/, tests/, fixtures/, scripts/`；零 GPU、不采集、不开窗、不改任何判据/阈值/相机/recipe/参考。
**非声明**：不宣称采集有效 / per-world 灯验收 / 上游等价 / 任何渲染数值结论；签名不等于开窗、不等于 G-L2 通过。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 派工：用户已双签 S-3（计划 + floor 9,956），做签名留证卡。范围：S-3 证据（receipt/README/manifest）+ S-1/S-2 receipt 的 signature_status 与 S-1 signatures_required（additive）+ 两处 manifest + 本卡。spec.md 字节零改动（前后 sha 留证）。签名不构成开窗：G-L2 仍需 QA PASS + Chief token + 现场 floor 取更高 + monitor 60/60 + 零编译 + live==guard==stash；做完停手，G-L2 执行窗由 Backend 做、Chief 发 token。另：S-1/S-2 receipt 改动后必须重算其 manifest（否则清单与 receipt 不一致），故写范围含这两个 manifest。
